what.text: This page follows refugees from Myanmar living in India, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 76784 refugees from Myanmar in India, 5.0% of all refugees from Myanmar.
Bangladesh hosts by far the most refugees from Myanmar, followed by Malaysia, Thailand and India.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Myanmar in many years, most recently from 2021 to 2025 with the NUG, PSLF, CNF and PNLO.
It also records armed conflict over Karen territory with the KNU and over Kachin territory with the KIO, both active again from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 169 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, in the same years as these conflicts, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in India.
These are year-end totals for India only, reported to UNHCR.
